g.title: Entity Relationship Diagram created by erdantic

a.xlink:title:
hydromodpy.data.managers.config_schema.DataManagersConfig
Top-level ``[data]`` configuration for manager families.
The `types` list declares user-requested data families. The effective active set can also include planner-inferred families deduced from other sections (domain, flow) depending on `inference_mode`.
For each active type, the matching nested section can be validated dynamically: - `geology` already uses its dedicated Pydantic model (`GeologyConfig`), - `oceanic` uses `OceanicConfig`, - the other data families are kept as validated mappings for now.
Use this model for validation only. Runtime activation order is represented by ``DataLoadPlan`` and loaded by ``DataManagersRuntimeLoader``.

hydromodpy.data.variables.dem.config.DemConfig
Top-level DEM variable configuration.
The section declares one or more elevation sources. The loaded DEM can feed geographic preprocessing directly or be cached as a reusable data product.
Example TOML::
[data.dem]
[[data.dem.sources]] source = "ign_geoplateforme_dem" dataset = "bd-alti" resolution_m = 25.0 regions = ["Bretagne"]
[[data.dem.sources]] source = "custom" path = "data/my_dem.tif"

hydromodpy.data.variables.etp.config.EtpConfig
Top-level potential evapotranspiration configuration.
The section groups ETP sources and an optional date window. Loaded data can be used by land-surface coupling, recharge estimation, or atmospheric forcing workflows.

hydromodpy.data.variables.geology.config.GeologyConfig
Top-level geology variable configuration.
The section defines one or more geology sources and the sampling density used when categorical geology is projected onto mesh cells. By default, HydroModPy uses the BRGM 1:1M source so geology can be activated by planner inference without a long user section.
Example TOML::
[data.geology] cell_samples_per_axis = 8
[[data.geology.sources]] source = "brgm_1m"
[[data.geology.sources]] source = "custom" path = "data/my_geology.gpkg" code_field = "LITHOLOGY"

hydromodpy.data.variables.humidity.config.HumidityConfig
Top-level relative-humidity configuration.
The section groups humidity sources and an optional date window. Loaded data can support atmospheric forcing, evapotranspiration context, and HELP coupling.

hydromodpy.data.variables.hydrography.config.HydrographyConfig
Top-level hydrography configuration.
The section lists stream-network sources used by data loading and boundary preparation. It is commonly inferred when ``flow.active_bc`` contains a stream boundary condition.

hydromodpy.data.variables.hydrometry.config.HydrometryConfig
Top-level hydrometry configuration.
The section groups hydrometric sources and the optional simulation date window inherited from ``BaseVariableConfig``. Loaded data is stored as station time series for calibration, boundary checks, or reporting.

hydromodpy.data.variables.intermittency.config.IntermittencyConfig
Top-level intermittency configuration.
The section groups flow-state observation sources and an optional date window. Loaded data can be used to compare simulated drying or active stream behavior against observed intermittency states.

hydromodpy.data.variables.lake_abacus.config.LakeAbacusConfig
Top-level lake-abacus variable configuration.
Example TOML::
[[data.lake_abacus.sources]] source = "custom" path = "data/lake_abacus/lake_abacus_custom_lac0.csv" lake_id = "lac0"

hydromodpy.data.variables.lake_bathymetry.config.LakeBathymetryConfig
Top-level lake-bathymetry variable configuration.
Example TOML::
[[data.lake_bathymetry.sources]] source = "custom" path = "data/lake_bathymetry/lake_bathymetry_custom_lac0.tif"

hydromodpy.data.variables.lake_geometry.config.LakeGeometryConfig
Top-level lake-geometry variable configuration.
Example TOML::
[[data.lake_geometry.sources]] source = "custom" path = "data/lake_geometry/lake_geometry_custom_lac0.gpkg"

hydromodpy.data.variables.lake_inflow.config.LakeInflowConfig
Top-level lake-inflow configuration.
The section groups observed lake-inflow sources and the optional simulation date window inherited from ``BaseVariableConfig``.

hydromodpy.data.variables.lake_levels.config.LakeLevelsConfig
Top-level lake-levels configuration.
The section groups observed lake-level sources and the optional simulation date window inherited from ``BaseVariableConfig``.

hydromodpy.data.variables.lake_outflow.config.LakeOutflowConfig
Top-level lake-outflow configuration.
The section groups observed lake-outflow sources and the optional simulation date window inherited from ``BaseVariableConfig``.

hydromodpy.data.variables.lake_withdrawal.config.LakeWithdrawalConfig
Top-level lake-withdrawal configuration.
The section groups observed lake-withdrawal sources and the optional simulation date window inherited from ``BaseVariableConfig``.

hydromodpy.data.variables.oceanic.config.OceanicConfig
Top-level oceanic configuration.
The section groups sea-level sources and an optional date window. It is commonly inferred when ``flow.active_bc`` contains an ocean boundary condition.

hydromodpy.data.variables.piezometry.config.PiezometryConfig
Top-level piezometry configuration.
The section groups groundwater observation sources and an optional date window. Loaded piezometric series can support calibration targets, diagnostics, and hydrogeological context.

hydromodpy.data.variables.precipitation.config.PrecipitationConfig
Top-level precipitation configuration.
The section groups precipitation sources and an optional date window. Loaded data can drive hydrological forcing, recharge derivation, or diagnostic comparisons.

hydromodpy.data.variables.radiation.config.RadiationConfig
Top-level radiation configuration.
The section groups radiation sources and an optional date window. Loaded data can support atmospheric forcing, potential evapotranspiration context, and HELP coupling.

hydromodpy.data.variables.recharge.config.RechargeConfig
Top-level recharge configuration.
The section groups recharge sources and an optional date window. Loaded recharge is used by groundwater and coupled flow workflows as a time-series or gridded forcing.

hydromodpy.data.variables.runoff.config.RunoffConfig
Top-level runoff configuration.
The section groups runoff sources and an optional date window. Loaded data can support hydrological forcing, recharge/runoff partitioning checks, and diagnostic comparisons.

hydromodpy.data.variables.soil_moisture.config.SoilMoistureConfig
Top-level soil-moisture configuration.
The section groups soil-moisture sources and an optional date window. Loaded data can support hydrological diagnostics and land-surface forcing analyses.

hydromodpy.data.variables.temperature.config.TemperatureConfig
Top-level air-temperature configuration.
The section groups temperature sources and an optional date window. Loaded data can support atmospheric forcing, HELP coupling, and diagnostic analyses.

hydromodpy.data.variables.water_quality.config.WaterQualityConfig
Top-level water quality configuration.
The section groups water-quality sources and an optional date window. It is designed for post-processing, model evaluation, and calibration workflows that compare simulated variables against observed chemistry.

hydromodpy.data.variables.wind.config.WindConfig
Top-level wind-speed configuration.
The section groups wind sources and an optional date window. Loaded data can support atmospheric forcing, evapotranspiration context, and HELP coupling.

hydromodpy.data.variables.dem.config.CustomDemSource
User-provided raster file (GeoTIFF, Esri ASCII Grid, NetCDF).

hydromodpy.data.variables.dem.config.IgnGeoplateformeDemSource
Recommended IGN DEM source assembled from Geoplateforme archives.

hydromodpy.data.variables.etp.config.EtpSourceConfig
Configuration for one potential evapotranspiration data source.
ETP sources load potential evapotranspiration from custom files or SIM2 EDR products. Source-level fields define station columns, gridded file paths, masks, units, and cache refresh behavior.

hydromodpy.data.variables.geology.config.BrgmGeology1mSource
BRGM 1:1M national geological map (CODE_LEG legend).

hydromodpy.data.variables.geology.config.BrgmGeology50kSource
BRGM 1:50K departmental geological map (CODE_LEG legend).

hydromodpy.data.variables.geology.config.CustomGeologySource
User-provided geology file (SHP/GPKG/TIF/CSV).

hydromodpy.data.variables.humidity.config.HumiditySourceConfig
Configuration for one relative-humidity data source.
Humidity sources load station or gridded relative-humidity time series from custom files or SIM2 EDR products. Source-level fields define file paths, station columns, masks, units, and cache refresh behavior.

hydromodpy.data.variables.hydrography.config.HydrographySourceConfig
Configuration for one hydrography data source.
Hydrography sources describe river-network vector or raster data. Use ``custom`` for local files, ``osm`` for OpenStreetMap waterways, ``bdtopage`` for the Sandre WFS service, or ``euhydro`` for the EEA EU-Hydro service.

hydromodpy.data.variables.hydrometry.config.HydrometrySourceConfig
Configuration for one hydrometry data source.
Hydrometry sources load river discharge or stage time series. Use ``custom`` for local station files and ``hubeau`` for the French Hub'Eau hydrometry API. Station filters, spatial masks, and units are declared at source level.

hydromodpy.data.variables.intermittency.config.IntermittencySourceConfig
Configuration for one intermittency data source.
Intermittency sources load stream flow-state observations from local files or from the Hub'Eau ONDE API. The source can restrict stations by id, department code, project extent, or a spatial mask.

hydromodpy.data.variables.lake_abacus.config.CustomLakeAbacusSource
User-provided lake abacus file (CSV/Parquet).
The abacus is the stage-volume-area lookup table that drives ``ModflowUtllaktab``. One source describes one lake; ``lake_id`` is injected into the table when the file omits the column.

hydromodpy.data.variables.lake_bathymetry.config.CustomLakeBathymetrySource
User-provided lake bathymetry raster (GeoTIFF/ASC).
The bathymetry raster fixes the lake-bed elevation per cell - i.e. where and at what depth the lake exchanges with the aquifer (the LAK interface). It is consumed only when a lake enables ``flow.sinks_sources.lakes.<id>.bed_reconstruction``: the raster is then resampled onto the lake cells, reconciled to the abacus, and carved into ``top``/``botm`` so the bed follows the real basin. Without that flag the raster is loaded but unused (the abacus alone drives the stage-storage relation).

hydromodpy.data.variables.lake_geometry.config.CustomLakeGeometrySource
User-provided lake geometry file (SHP/GPKG/GeoJSON).
The vector file holds the lake/reservoir footprint polygon(s) - and, where relevant, the dam line and outlet points - that the LAK builder intersects with the DISV mesh to resolve the lake cells.

hydromodpy.data.variables.lake_inflow.config.LakeInflowSourceConfig
Configuration for one lake-inflow data source.
Lake-inflow sources load observed volumetric inflow (L^3/T) time series per lake. The station id reused per chronicle is the ``lake_id``.

hydromodpy.data.variables.lake_levels.config.LakeLevelsSourceConfig
Configuration for one lake-levels data source.
Lake-level sources load observed water-surface elevation time series used as a calibration target. The station id reused per chronicle is the ``lake_id``.

hydromodpy.data.variables.lake_outflow.config.LakeOutflowSourceConfig
Configuration for one lake-outflow data source.
Lake-outflow sources load observed volumetric outflow (L^3/T) time series per lake. The station id reused per chronicle is the ``lake_id``.

hydromodpy.data.variables.lake_withdrawal.config.LakeWithdrawalSourceConfig
Configuration for one lake-withdrawal data source.
Lake-withdrawal sources load observed volumetric withdrawal (L^3/T) time series per lake. The station id reused per chronicle is the ``lake_id``.

hydromodpy.data.variables.oceanic.config.OceanicSourceConfig
Configuration for one oceanic boundary data source.
Oceanic sources describe sea-level information for coastal boundary conditions. Use ``custom`` for local files, ``shom`` for tide-gauge data, or ``constant`` for a fixed mean sea-level value.

hydromodpy.data.variables.piezometry.config.PiezometrySourceConfig
Configuration for one piezometry data source.
Piezometry sources load groundwater-level or depth observations from local station files or from the Hub'Eau piezometry API. Station filters, nearest station selection, and source units are declared here.

hydromodpy.data.variables.precipitation.config.PrecipitationSourceConfig
Configuration for one precipitation data source.
Precipitation sources provide rainfall, snowfall, or total precipitation from custom files or SIM2 EDR products. Components select which precipitation signal is loaded from the provider.

hydromodpy.data.variables.radiation.config.RadiationSourceConfig
Configuration for one radiation data source.
Radiation sources load atmospheric and/or visible radiation from custom files or SIM2 EDR products. Components select the radiation signals used by downstream forcing and HELP coupling.

hydromodpy.data.variables.recharge.config.RechargeSourceConfig
Configuration for one recharge data source.
Recharge sources provide water input to the subsurface as custom files, SIM2 gridded products, or synthetic series. Synthetic fields can be constant, time-varying, or sinusoidal depending on the declared values and optional amplitude settings.

hydromodpy.data.variables.runoff.config.RunoffSourceConfig
Configuration for one runoff data source.
Runoff sources load station or gridded surface-runoff time series from custom files or SIM2 EDR products. Source-level fields define file paths, station columns, masks, units, and cache refresh behavior.

hydromodpy.data.variables.soil_moisture.config.SoilMoistureSourceConfig
Configuration for one soil-moisture data source.
Soil-moisture sources load station or gridded soil-moisture indices from custom files or SIM2 EDR products. Source-level fields define file paths, station columns, masks, units, and cache refresh behavior.

hydromodpy.data.variables.temperature.config.TemperatureSourceConfig
Configuration for one air-temperature data source.
Temperature sources load station or gridded air-temperature time series from custom files or SIM2 EDR products. Source-level fields define file paths, station columns, masks, units, and cache refresh behavior.

hydromodpy.data.variables.water_quality.config.WaterQualitySourceConfig
Configuration for one water quality data source.
Water-quality sources load physico-chemical observations for river or piezometer sites. The source selects local files or Hub'Eau, optional parameter filters, station filters, and spatial discovery rules.

hydromodpy.data.variables.wind.config.WindSourceConfig
Configuration for one wind-speed data source.
Wind sources load station or gridded wind-speed time series from custom files or SIM2 EDR products. Source-level fields define file paths, station columns, masks, units, and cache refresh behavior.
